title: Broken, dangerous & harmful to health
text:
Broken, dangerous & harmful to health. I was very hopeful about this tortilla press.

Boy was I mistaken!

For starters: this arrived damaged. The packaging they used offered zero protection for something that will no doubt be tossed around in transit.

I am still cleaning the bits of nikel (or whatever heavy metal that is coating the press) from my kitchen where I initially opened the package.

Also, I am nursing a large cut on my finger from a piece of portruding sharp metal on the press's handle.

The outer coating continues to fall off with no end in sight.

I would not advise for anyone to buy this dangerous product.

product_metadata.title: Estrella 7.5" Cast Iron Tortilla press Heavy Made In MEXICO
